answer: A farm paying its aliases from one wallet therefore collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Because the saffron graph is rebuilt each epoch, the atlas merge is applied at settlement and the glacier audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 30 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 18 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
